title: Cargo hygiene: serde_json not inherited, rustls declared but unused
description:
Two Cargo-level problems. (The empty `goa`/`pkcs11` feature flags are persona-5s4b.42 — but note that issue's claim that there is "no cfg(feature = \"goa\") or cfg(feature = \"pkcs11\") anywhere" is not quite right: goa.rs:28-34 and piv.rs:26-33 both do gate on them. The gating is just inert, because in piv.rs both arms return `false` and in goa.rs the `enumerate` stub returns `Ok(vec![])` either way. Same conclusion, different reason.)

1. persona-core/Cargo.toml:14 — `serde_json = "1"` is specified inline while every other dependency in that crate uses `.workspace = true`, and the workspace root already declares `serde_json = "1"` at Cargo.toml:32. Two independent version specs for one dependency: bumping the workspace entry silently leaves persona-core behind, and the divergence is invisible until someone diffs the two manifests. Change to `serde_json.workspace = true`.

2. `rustls` is declared by persona-grpc/Cargo.toml:18 and personad/Cargo.toml:17 and used by neither. Grepping `rustls` across every .rs file in the workspace returns exactly one hit and it is inside a comment — personad/src/main.rs:12, the ponytail note about a future axum-plus-rustls HTTP gateway. Both crates therefore build rustls 0.23 with its ring backend for nothing: build time, plus a TLS stack in the dependency audit surface that no code can reach. Remove both declarations and add rustls back when the gateway lands.

Verified the other plausible-looking candidates are genuinely used, so this is the whole list: serde_json in personad/src/main.rs:40, libc and sha2 in persona-grpc/src/consumer_attest.rs, tokio-stream in persona/src/main.rs:412.
